integrity.reproducibility: verify.py uses the Python standard library and exact rational arithmetic

scientific_limitations: Only Euclidean enclosing balls constrained to touch a specified point and have centers on the inward normal ray are considered.
The global uniform ellipsoid ball-support radius is an established result and is not claimed as new.
Historical priority of the sharp pointwise spectral formula and complete far-contact classification is not independently verified.
Numerical/exact-rational samples are finite and do not replace the universal analytic argument.
title: Minimal tangent-ball radii and far-contact foliation of Euclidean ellipsoids
